input_messages.content: Hi! I actually need some help with my account and a couple of recent orders. I just moved to a new house on Elm Avenue here in Houston, and I noticed that one of my orders was sent to my old address. I’d like to get that order’s shipping address updated to my new place, and also have my default address changed for future orders. Can you help with that?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account.

I’d prefer not to type out my address—since both my old and new homes are on Elm Avenue in Houston, you should be able to see them in my recent orders. Could you please just update the shipping address for the order that’s going to the old address to my new one, and also set my new Elm Avenue address as my default? I want to make sure everything is consistent moving forward.

Also, once we get the address sorted, I’d like to exchange the tablet I just bought for the cheapest tablet you have, since moving has been expensive. Can you help with that too?

Yes, that’s exactly right! Please update the shipping address for order #W1092119 to 760 Elm Avenue, Suite 564, and make that my default address for all future orders.

Once that’s done, I’d like to move forward with exchanging my tablet for the most affordable one you have. Let me know what the next steps are for the exchange.
You can use my Mastercard ending in 3292 for any price difference or refund. Please go ahead and let me know what the cheapest tablet option is and what the exchange process will look like. Thanks!

Yes, I confirm that I’ve provided all the changes I want for this order. Please go ahead and update the order and process the refund. Thanks for making this so easy!

That’s perfect, thank you so much for your help! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
